limitations: No USB power meter — cannot prove efficiency, over-current, or PD/PPS compliance.
No IR/probe surface temps — brick/cable heat is manual 'too hot to hold' only.
Safety is relative to OEM device logs + absolute-stop notes, not lab certification.
If batt_temp_c is unavailable on the device OS, heat evidence is weaker; say so before any verdict.

safety.notes: Baseline envelopes are measured from OEM repeats; null means not evaluated (fail closed).
Do not recommend unless safety_pass is explicitly true.

scoring_notes.better: safety_pass AND clearly better on ≥1 primary metric without exceeding worse-margins on others
scoring_notes.equivalent: safety_pass AND primary metrics within OEM equivalence bands
scoring_notes.worse: safety_pass but meaningfully slower / hotter / less consistent than OEM
scoring_notes.do_not_recommend: any safety fail — blocks recommendation regardless of speed
scoring_notes.null_safety_pass: treated as not passed (fail closed); never invent a pass
